profile.summary: Mid-level JavaScript developer with deep expertise in Node.js and npm CLI internals. Specializes in debugging core npm functionality, improving testing reliability, and enhancing code consistency. Strong background in JavaScript core features, version compatibility, and automated development workflows. Contributes primarily through targeted fixes, refactoring, and documentation improvements in the npm CLI repository. Demonstrates collaborative problem-solving and attention to detail in both code and technical documentation.
